span.p:
IsaacBox obs 75 → act 21 · 128×3 ELU · 45,611 params
base_lin_vel(3) base_ang_vel(3) projected_gravity(3) target_pos_b(3)
joint_pos_rel(21) joint_vel_rel(21) last_action(21)
target = default + 0.5 · a · implicit PD · policy 50 Hz

same layout, velocity_commands(3) in place of target_pos_b
no Sub/Div nodes: raw Gemm+Elu only

[0 .. 3N) per joint, ×N
jointPosition[0] / (45° · deg2rad), clamp ±1
jointVelocity[0] / 10 rad·s&⁻¹, clamp ±1
Sensor_LimbContact.IsGrounded → 1 or 0

root.position.y (1, raw metres)

clamp01(|toGoal| / 20 m) (1)

span.p:
[3N+15 .. 3N+19) terrain look-ahead
Physics.Raycast down from +3 m, range 6 m,
at 0.5 / 1.2 / 2.2 / 3.5 m along flattened forward
(hit.y − root.y) / 2, clamp ±1

div.style: color: rgb(74, 15, 13) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Safe() / SafeVector() on every element
one exploded body must never feed NaN into the sensor —
that aborts the Academy step for every agent in the scene
